Kata.Arti_kata_in: binatang yang diberi kalung untuk korban

Kata.Arti_kata_en: and that which is strangled (to death)
and that which is hit fatally
and that which has a fatal fall
and that which is gored by horns
ones who train animals to hunt

Kata.Arti_kata_in: dan sungguh Aku akan memasukkan kamu
Kata.Arti_kata_en: and I will surely admit you
and surely We (would have) admitted them
He will call you to account

Kata.Arti_kata_in: dan mengundi nasib dengan anak panah
haam (unta larangan yang tidak boleh dibebani)

Kata.Arti_kata_en: you have spoken the truth to us
